excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的毒性粘液已被清除，而最后一道裂隙也已被填上，以防止更多毒性液体泄漏至地表。
excerpt.en: The toxic sludge on [Root.GetName] has been cleared and the last rifts filled, preventing more noxious gases from leaking to the surface.
